past.title: CCCHR Monthly Meeting | Dec. 23rd
past.body:
Join us for our Monthly Meetings | 4th Tuesday of Every Month

All car club member/representatives are invited to our meetings, which are scheduled the fourth Tuesday of every month. We’ll be discussing what and how the Car Club Council can help and represent the car clubs of the Southside of Hampton Roads and Northern North Carolina. Our goal is to provide a sounding board for all car clubs on the Southside and to be a single voice in support of automotive legislative activities in Virginia and North Carolina. As well as a single location to advertise car club member events on our website calendar. We will also provide a central point for advertising of automotive related facilities and products.

Looking forward to seeing you all at the meeting!

DUES ARE $30.00 FOR ALL CAR CLUBS AND ARE DUE TO THE TREASURER BY MARCH OF EACH YEAR.

Please park behind the building and enter through the Parts department door. For all you guys driving lowered vehicles, beware that the parking lot is full of speed bumps. 1495 South Military Highway, Chesapeake, VA 23320

past.title: Cars and Coffee Chesapeake | Dec. 13th
past.body:
Cars and Coffee Chesapeake

Saturday, Dec 13th | 8a-11a

Located at Everbowl - 1244 Greenbrier Pkwy #570, Chesapeake, VA 23320

Team Ultraspeed and Everbowl are teaming up to bring you the best Cars and Coffee meets in the area! Join us for a community gathering of the most beautiful cars from near and far. Enjoy a hot cup of coffee or a delicious treat from Everbowl, while admiring a variety of amazing vehicles from different makes, models, and eras. Chat with other car lovers, exchange tips, and share you experiences over a delicious breakfast or lunch.

You won't want to miss this, so mark your calendars and we'll see you there!

past.title: Boost and Brunch NN | Nov. 9th
past.body:
(2nd Sun) Boost and Brunch NN

SUNDAY, Nov. 9th | 8:30-11a

Located at 369 Chatham Dr, Newport News, VA 23602-4382, United States

Rev up your engines and fuel your passion for cars at our event! Whether you're a gearhead or just love seeing stunning rides, this is the place to be. Join us for a morning filled with:

Classic cars, exotic rides, and custom builds
Freshly brewed coffee to kickstart your day*
Meet fellow car enthusiasts and share stories
Music, vibes, vendors, and more!

Our 5th Annual Kars4Kids car show! Same time, same place! Mark your calendars and don't miss out this year! We are currently accepting sponsors and vendors! Pre-registration is open!
